data.gender_notes: Lorrayne is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Latin word 'lux' meaning 'light', this name signifies a bright or shining individual. In Christian tradition, it is also linked to the biblical name 'Laura', meaning 'bay leaf' or 'lyre', symbolizing a connection to nature and music. The name Lorrayne carries the meaning “Light, bright, or shining one” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Lorrayne usually hope their child will grow to embody light, bright, or shining one and live with faith, good character and purpose.
